trigger: Owned harness or crew changes are ready to commit.
steps: Run shell syntax checks for touched shell entrypoints.
Run the repository operational harness foundation test.
Run git diff --check against the declared base.
Do not weaken a failing validator; repair within owned scope or route to failure-recovery.
failure_handling: Preserve output and return to failure-recovery with the exact failing validator and responsible owner.
proof_ceiling: workflow-state evidence only unless the owning runtime/validator produces stronger proof
